definition: A JavaScript function that prints values to the terminal so you can see program output.
Text data in JavaScript, written in quotes like "hello" or using template strings like `Hello ${name}`.
A reusable named block of code that can take inputs (parameters) and return an output.
An input variable listed in a function definition (e.g., `name` in `greet(name)`).
The output a function produces using `return`, which can be stored or used by other code.
